messages:
carmen: Heads-up — bringing up Vesper-3b (int8) on dev-staging today. I ran a quick smoke pass, posting notes here for prioritization and follow-ups.

rahul: Thanks. Can you paste the minimal checklist you used?

carmen: Sure — short version: 1) deploy model artefact to devstg slot, 2) run /health and /version, 3) run 10 sanity prompts (instruction, code, math, factual), 4) check logits/kvcache anomalies, 5) compare original float32 vs int8 outputs for regressions, 6) capture latency/throughput with small batch sweep.

jin: Ping me for the quant mismatch tests. I have a quick diff script.

carmen: Running commands I used:
```bash
# deploy (internal deploy helper)
./bin/deploy --env=devstg --model=vesper-3b-int8 --tag=2026-03-20-quantA
# basic health check
curl -s https://devstg-api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .
```
Response: {"ok":true, "model":"vesper-3b-int8", "kernels":"cuda-fused"}

ops-bot: Deploy started by carmen — job id dpl-8492. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/dpl-8492

carmen: Sanity prompts I used (and short results):
1) Instruction: "Summarize the paragraph in one sentence." -> ok, concise.
2) Code: "Write a Python function to swap two list elements." -> ok, compiles in head; minor stylistic diff.
3) Math: "What is 17*23?" -> expected 391, model returned 399 (worrying).
4) Factual: "Who wrote 'Pride and Prejudice'?" -> returns correct.

sasha: The math error stands out. Is it only int8 or present in float run?

carmen: Good call. I ran the same prompt against the latest float32 candidate (vesper-3b-fp32): it returned 391 correctly. So regression introduced after quantization.

rahul: Do we have logit traces? Can you capture the top tokens and logits for the step where number emitted?

carmen: Captured snippet (sanitized):
```
step 8: input="17*23" -> top tokens: ['399', '391', '415']
logits: [3.1, 2.9, 2.1]  # pseudo numbers for quick glance
```
Note: logits are softer toward wrong token. Could be precision loss on multiplication chain in generation.

jin: Looks like quantization shifted a few logits. I can run symmetric vs asymmetric quant tests. Also will try per-channel quant and check residuals.

carmen: Latency: single-token generation (cold): 120ms, warmed steady-state 85ms on a mid-tier T4-equivalent. Batch-4 throughput ~ 180 tok/s. No OOMs.

eva: Those latencies look fine. For prioritization: math hallucination must be high priority (affects correctness), code/style diffs medium, performance is green.

rahul: Agreed. Proposed next steps: A) run diffing harness across our 200-unit numeric QA set, B) run per-layer quantization diagnostics from jin, C) if regression concentrated in early layers, try higher precision for softmax/kvcache, D) open an issue and tag ML-quantization.

carmen: I created issue #ML-523: "Vesper-3b int8: numeric regressions on arithmetic prompts" and attached raw traces + deploy id.

ops-bot: Issue ML-523 created by carmen. Linked to dpl-8492.

jin: Starting per-channel quant runs now (est ~45m). Will post artifacts.

carmen: Also noticed a minor tokenization discrepancy for one prompt with punctuation — int8 emitted an extra space before comma in ~2/10 trials. Could be rounding noise in BPE scores. Marking low priority but add to checklist.

rahul: For the prioritization board: high=math regressions, medium=tokenization spacing, low=style differences. Any objections?

sasha: No objections. For rollout policy, do not promote to dedicated until a signoff from jin + ML lead.

carmen: Agreed. Tentative owner for signoff: jin for quant diagnostics, sasha for eval pass. I'll re-run the 200 numeric cases after jin posts diagnostics.

jin: Uploading per-layer residual plots: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/ml/vesper/int8/2026-03-20/plots.zip

carmen: Thanks. If jin flags layer 3 softmax, we can try keeping softmax at float16 as an intermediate measure.

rahul: Add one more check: end-to-end token-level diff stats (F1/precision on debug prompts) and a small human eval run for naturalness. We'll need a baseline pass before any larger rollout.

carmen: Will coordinate the small human eval (~20 prompts) with product QA tomorrow. For now, pausing promotion.

eva: Thanks for the clear notes — this is a good concise pulse. :thumbsup:

carmen: Thanks all — I'll post updates in this thread as we get diffs and human eval results.
